name: Self-adhesive no-drill metal bathroom shelf, pack of 4
supplier_cost_note: IndiaMART bathroom-shelves category: metal wall-mounted self-adhesive shelf 27x11x6.5 cm Rs 69/piece x 4 (snippet; seller/MOQ not shown). Plastic self-adhesive shelf Rs 65-125/piece.
retail_observed: Pack of 2 on Amazon.in: Amazon Basics aluminium Rs 217 (deal, 15 Oct 2026), Oslen Rs 299, MorivaHomes Rs 298, VR Prime Rs 499, Hallstatt Rs 672; Pepperfry pack of 2 Rs 400; Primax pack of 4 Rs 1,940 (GlobalBees). Rs 649 for 4 is mid-market.

demand_signals.summary: 2026 Indian guide lists several no-drill pack-of-2 metal shelves on Amazon at Rs 298-672
Amazon Basics pack-of-2 deal updated 15 Oct 2026 at Rs 217, showing active, price-competitive demand

risks: Adhesive failure on tiles is a common complaint and return reason
Strong low-price competition (Rs 217 for 2 on deal)
Rust claims on GI/metal need evidence
Weight of 4 metal shelves not confirmed; le_2kg assumed
Sharp edges / bent shelves in transit

review.notes: Margin is 8.5% at best (Rs 43/order), far below the 30% target, and a higher price is not supportable with pack-of-2 deals at Rs 217; adhesive failure on tiles and transit bending add return risk.
